activerecord: ActiveRecord: the library, and this pack's name
create: ActiveRecord: builds and stores a row
insert: ActiveRecord: adds a row without callbacks
insert_all: ActiveRecord: adds several rows without callbacks
update: ActiveRecord: writes changed attributes to matched rows
update_all: ActiveRecord: writes to every matched row without callbacks
upsert: ActiveRecord: adds or overwrites one row
upsert_all: ActiveRecord: adds or overwrites several rows
destroy: ActiveRecord: removes a row, running callbacks
destroy_all: ActiveRecord: removes every matched row, running callbacks
delete: ActiveRecord: removes a row without callbacks
delete_all: ActiveRecord: removes every matched row without callbacks
find: ActiveRecord::FinderMethods#find: the record with the given primary key
find_by: ActiveRecord::FinderMethods#find_by: the first record matching the given attributes
find_or_create_by: ActiveRecord::Relation#find_or_create_by: the matching record, stored if it was not there
find_or_initialize_by: ActiveRecord::Relation#find_or_initialize_by: the matching record, built if it was not there
first: language: Ruby spells Array#first the same way. ActiveRecord::FinderMethods#first: the first record in the relation's order
last: language: Ruby spells Array#last the same way. ActiveRecord::FinderMethods#last: the last record in the relation's order
take: ActiveRecord::FinderMethods#take: one record, in no stated order
sole: ActiveRecord::FinderMethods#sole: the only record, raising when there is not exactly one
find_sole_by: ActiveRecord::FinderMethods#find_sole_by: the only record matching, raising when there is not exactly one
new: ActiveRecord::Core#new: builds a record without storing it
build: ActiveRecord::Relation#build: builds a record from the relation's scope without storing it
reload: ActiveRecord::Persistence#reload: reads the receiver's row again
where: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#where: narrows a relation by the given conditions
rewhere: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#rewhere: replaces the conditions already on the relation
or: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#or: matches either this relation's rows or the other's
order: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#order: sets the relation's sort order
reorder: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#reorder: replaces the sort order already on the relation
limit: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#limit: caps how many rows the relation reads
offset: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#offset: skips rows before the relation starts reading
includes: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#includes: loads the named associations along with the rows
preload: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#preload: loads the named associations in separate queries
eager_load: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#eager_load: loads the named associations in one joined query
joins: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#joins: joins the named associations or tables
left_joins: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#left_joins: left outer joins the named associations
left_outer_joins: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#left_outer_joins: left outer joins the named associations
distinct: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#distinct: drops duplicate rows from the relation
select: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#select: picks which columns the relation reads
group: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#group: groups the relation's rows by the given columns
having: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#having: filters the groups a grouped relation produced
merge: ActiveRecord::SpawnMethods#merge: folds another relation's conditions into this one
readonly: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#readonly: marks the relation's records as not writable
lock: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#lock: locks the rows the relation reads
none: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#none: a relation that matches no rows
all: ActiveRecord::Scoping::Named#all: a relation over every row of the model
unscoped: ActiveRecord::Scoping::Default#unscoped: a relation with the default scope taken off
unscope: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#unscope: takes the named parts of the query off the relation
extending: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#extending: mixes the given modules into the relation
from: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#from: sets what the relation selects from
references: ActiveRecord::QueryMethods#references: says which included associations the conditions mention
only: ActiveRecord::SpawnMethods#only: keeps only the named parts of the query
except: ActiveRecord::SpawnMethods#except: drops the named parts of the query
has_many: ActiveRecord::Associations::ClassMethods#has_many: declares a collection of another model
has_one: ActiveRecord::Associations::ClassMethods#has_one: declares one record of another model
belongs_to: ActiveRecord::Associations::ClassMethods#belongs_to: declares the model this one's foreign key points at
has_and_belongs_to_many: ActiveRecord::Associations::ClassMethods#has_and_belongs_to_many: declares a collection joined through a table with no model
class_name: ActiveRecord::Associations::ClassMethods: the option that says which class an association reaches, when the association's name does not
